badRecordsExit.go: rc=2 and the install must stop for confirmation

classification.go: netcfg.Classify (IPv6 before IPv4, order preserved, no dedupe)

dnsProbe.bash: validate_domain_network_records probes an external echo service to learn the public address
dnsProbe.go: no outbound echo probe; the server address comes from --server-ipv4/6 or the local interfaces

ipv6FailClosed.bash: falls back to iptables alone in auto mode
ipv6FailClosed.go: a dual/ipv6 mode without ip6tables refuses before touching any rule

stateLayout.bash: no explicit managed-state file; the Bash config is the source of truth
